meta.why: A lead is captured the moment there is a NAME + handle (plan 04, low-threshold house rule). Runs in PARALLEL with the answer — capture must never wait for Maya's mouth, because the viewer who typed 'אני רוצה' is the whole point of the stream.
meta.setup: 1) CONFIG.maya_api = maya-server URL, CONFIG.sheet_id = the client's Google Sheet id. 2) Attach a Google Sheets credential. 3) Sheet needs a 'Leads' tab with the header row: ts | platform | name | handle | product | message. 4) Optional: attach a Telegram credential to the operator ping, or delete that node.
meta.trigger_words: Hebrew and English both — 'אני רוצה', 'רוצה', 'לקנות', 'i want', 'buy', 'how do i order'. Wide on purpose: a missed lead costs the client money, a false one costs a row in a sheet.
